entries.subject: Codex architectural review completed and design refined
entries.text: Executed scripts/consult_codex_architecture.py via codex exec. Codex provided a comprehensive review (recorded in docs/design/CODEX_CONFIGURATION_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md). All critical and high findings were incorporated into UI2_CONFIGURATION_MICROSERVICE_ARCHITECTURE.md: (1) ui2-configuration is strictly an internal stateless parsing/sanitization service with no direct DB or device access; (2) ui2-worker remains single device-contact and persistence owner; (3) input protocol is streaming binary/text rather than large JSON strings; (4) Check Point parser guarantees exact 1:1 fidelity with Python collector (exact .strip(), null hash on empty output, 4-line header, no synthetic services section); (5) Palo Alto SPI will reuse existing StAX XML processor without CLI set mode; (6) K8s deployment uses internal ClusterIP, non-root, read-only rootfs, and simple health probes; (7) aiview field classification and leak tests are required before configuration endpoints are exposed to replay viewers. Architecture consensus reached and ready for PO implementation authorization.

entries.subject: Authorized ui2-configuration implementation
entries.text: Authorized to proceed with the implementation of the ui2-configuration microservice adhering to the refined consensus architecture: internal stateless parser, exact Check Point 1:1 Python parity, Palo Alto extensible SPI, and aiview privacy compliance.

entries.subject: Implemented ui2-configuration microservice and 1:1 CP parser
entries.text: Implemented the ui2-configuration microservice and core SPI in ui2/worker: (1) VendorConfigParser SPI with ConfigVendor, ConfigFormat, ConfigParseContext, ConfigParseResult; (2) CheckPointGaiaConfigParser with byte-for-byte parity to Python checkpoint configuration collector (canonical SHA-256 hash over set lines, PASSWORD_POLICY_SAFE_RE safe knob preservation, SECRET_LINE_RE keyword withholding, MESSAGE_BODY_RE banner body masking, 14 governed sections, setting AST breakdown, and operator highlights); (3) PaloAltoConfigParser extensible SPI wrapper for PAN-OS StAX XML processor; (4) Ui2ConfigurationServer lightweight stateless HTTP server on port 8084 exposing GET /healthz and POST /api/v1/parse; (5) Ui2WorkerMain workload dispatch for 'configuration' role; (6) K8s manifest deploy/ui2/54-configuration-deployment.yaml; (7) All unit and architecture tests pass cleanly, repository privacy check passes with 0 findings.
